questions.question: Which logic gate produces the Sum output of a Half Adder?
questions.explanation: The XOR gate outputs 1 when inputs are different (0+1=1, 1+0=1) and 0 when same (1+1=0 with carry).

questions.question: How many NAND gates are required to implement a 1-bit Half Adder?
questions.explanation: 4 NAND gates form the XOR (Sum) and 1 additional NAND acts as inverter for AND (Carry), totaling 5 NAND gates.
